author: Pallas, 1773

months.note: 겨울철에 다른 두루미 무리에 섞여 드물게 관찰된다.

summary: 국내에는 매우 드물게 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 겨울철 다른 두루미 무리에 섞인 1~2마리가 드물게 보이거나 홀로 겨울을 난다. 습지와 논에서 지내며 긴 부리로 땅에 떨어진 식물 씨앗과 곤충, 물고기, 조개 따위를 먹는다. 러시아 오브강 유역과 시베리아 북동부 콜리마천 유역에서 번식하고 중국 포양호와 양쯔강 일대에서 겨울을 난다. 국내에서는 강원도 철원, 파주, 화성, 천수만, 만경강, 순천만, 흑산도, 제주도 등지에서 관찰된 기록이 있다.

points.en: bare red skin around the eye

points.ko: 앉아 있을 때 온통 흰 몸

points.en: long white tertials covering the primaries

young: 어린새는 온몸에 황갈색 깃과 흰 깃이 섞여 있고, 특히 머리와 날개덮깃, 셋째날개깃에 황갈색이 짙다.

art.subject: Siberian Crane (Leucogeranus leucogeranus), adult, sexes alike, in winter: entire plumage pure white at rest, including the neck and the long, drooping tertials, which cover the black primaries; the black primaries and primary coverts show only in flight or when the wings are opened; bare brick-red skin on the forehead and face, reaching back past the eye; bill long, dull pinkish-red; iris pale yellow; legs and feet pinkish-red.
art.pose: walking in a wet rice field, probing the ground with its long bill for fallen seeds
art.scene: Korean winter wetland beside harvested rice paddies; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing in a wet paddy: all-white plumage with long white tertials covering the black primaries, bare brick-red face reaching past the pale yellow eye, long pinkish-red bill, pinkish-red legs
adult, in flight seen from below: white body and wings with black primaries forming black outer wingtips, neck stretched forward and legs trailing, red face
juvenile, side view standing: white mixed with cinnamon-tawny feathers, tawny strongest on the head, neck, wing coverts and tertials, face feathered without red skin
art.build: Very large, tall white crane, about 135cm, taller than a Grey Heron and a little smaller than a Red-crowned Crane, with a long neck and long legs. Bill long, straight and fairly slender, clearly longer than the head. Legs very long, pinkish-red. At rest the long white tertials fall over the short tail as a white bustle. In flight neck and legs fully stretched out; white wings with black primaries forming black outer wingtips, the secondaries white.
avoid: Do not paint a black neck or black secondaries and tertials; that is Red-crowned Crane (Grus japonensis). This species shows black only on the primaries.
Do not paint a black bill or black along the whole trailing edge of the wing (Oriental Stork).
Do not paint a small red crown patch on a white head; the bare red skin covers the forehead and the face around the eye.
Do not paint grey body plumage or dark legs.
